title: Exchange Landing Pages: Promo Slots Are Not Vetting
summary: What our partner slots are — and aren't. Why a banner here never equals an endorsement of a venue's custody or solvency.

body.p: This hub hosts partner slots. That's the whole function: a labelled, paid placement pointing at an exchange landing page.
A sponsored slot is not a security audit, a solvency guarantee or a custody recommendation. Exchanges fail. Counterparty risk is real. Promotion simply means someone paid for the placement.

body.h: How to read our editorial reviews

body.p: Editorial exchange reviews in this section apply the same criteria regardless of who advertises. When a venue reviewed in an article is also an advertiser, the article says so explicitly.
